'''Sparkstick''' were small pyrotechnic devices used for illumination and lighting candles. They could only be used once.<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030501kessel|text=Kessel: Hell in Space|int=Kessel: Hell in Space}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sparksticks are similar to the real world [[Wikipedia:Matchstick|matchstick]].
